Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: editorial photograph for the company section of a contemporary Russian real-estate agency website mockup; fictional illustrative people.
Primary request: Candid warm collaborative scene of four adult real-estate colleagues in a tasteful everyday office reviewing a paper apartment floor plan at a meeting table. Two women and two men, ages 30–48, Russian and Central Asian appearances, naturally varied faces and hair, approachable ordinary professionals. A woman in a subtle muted sky-blue cotton blouse is speaking, colleagues are listening and smiling slightly, spontaneous authentic work rather than a posed stock photo.
Scene/backdrop: bright airy office, warm gray mineral walls, large window, understated oak meeting table, paper floor plans, a closed graphite laptop and ceramic coffee cups, small shelving in background. No excessive decoration.
Composition/framing: Landscape 3:2, eye level, medium group shot, faces large and clearly visible, whole group centered with slightly more weight on the right. Show natural hands resting on table and the paper floorplan. Keep every face away from outer edges; useful crop for website. Editorial architectural photography, realistic skin texture, professional color grading, restrained visual sophistication.
Lighting/mood: soft natural side daylight, warm and inviting, believable calm working atmosphere.
Color palette: graphite, stone, warm gray, warm oak, soft off-white with a restrained sky-blue accent in clothing.
Constraints: all people fictional; fully clothed; precise realistic human anatomy and ordinary believable gestures; no handshakes, no looking at camera, no luxury staging, no visible logos or brand names, no readable words, no captions, no watermarks.
